messages.subject: RStan Not Honoring Specified Inits?
parts:
I have a model that has a kind of multi-modal posterior due to a reflection invariance.

Is pseudo-code, I have two generalized IRT-like models:
ResponseA[j,k]~Dist(Link( a[k] + b[k]*LatentDimA[j]))

ResponseB[j,k]~Dist(Link( c[k] + d[k]*LatentDimB[j]))

Followed by a Cobbs-Douglas parameterized Poisson regression
Outcome[j]~Poisson(exp(  g1 + g2*log(Age) + g3*log(LatentDimA) + g4*log(LatentDimB) ))

There there is a reflection invariance between both the b[k]s and g3, and the d[k]s and g4, since the responses can 'load backward' on the latent dimension.

I don't want to impose any positive constraints on the model parameters to impose identification. Rather I want to start the chain at various inits, defining b,d,g3,and g4 in order to target the specific modes of the posterior, and check if the modes are just reflections.

However, when I try to define inits=0, or inits=INITS, which I specify myself, RStan does not seem to honor them. Instead, when i used get_inits() after I fit the model, I get a different set of inits.

So, my question is, Whats going on here? How do I get RStan to honor my defined inits?

Also, with this kind of model specification, is there a way of forcing the latent dimensions to never 'load backward'?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] RStan Not Honoring Specified Inits?
parts:
Hi Cody,

Regarding the subject of your email:

Initial values specified as inits=0 are on the unconstrained scale. If you have any constrained parameters, e.g. "real<lower=0> sigma", then an initial value of 0 on the unconstrained scale does not equal 0 on the constrained scale. See the chapter on transforms in the Stan manual for details on transforms.

I'm not sure which scale inits=INITS is specifying the initial values. 



Nonidentifiability is an issue. If you're model is running slow, you'll have to address that. If it's running fast enough, there won't be harm in post processing, except for the fact that you haven't reached stationary in any single chain, which would be made clear if individual chains are not exploring all modes.

Daniel

messages.author: d1237c2d244e29ff
messages.subject: Re: RStan Not Honoring Specified Inits?
parts:
Daniel,

Thanks for the quick reply. It looks like the problem is not just that the inits are on unconstrained space as opposed to constrained space, but that the inits are being generated randomly on {-2,2} instead on of 0 in unconstrained space, or as I specify them. The model runs quickly, and I can see the two major modes if I run enough chains, but id like to have control of the inits.

Can you try that and let us know if that works?

Daniel
